{{Quote|I wrote my father that it looked like a colony of squibs had moved into the Queen's collection of braaken glass.|Leia Organa, on the buildings of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]|<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
'''Braaken glass''' was a type of artistic craft. [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]], last [[Monarch of Alderaan|Queen]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], maintained a collection of braaken glass&mdash;much to the chagrin of her [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|husband]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|daughter]], who both found it hideous.<ref name="Shield of Lies" />
